title: Atlas 1.1 — Person Registry
description: Individuals referenced in CoreSyn governance or research, distinct from Agent Registry (executable identities). A person with an Agent Registry counterpart (e.g. the founder) is cross-referenced via agent_registry_ref, never duplicated as separate unlinked data.

status.description: UNVERIFIED_IN_THIS_SCOPE does not assert the person doesn't exist, only that this session found no independently verifiable identity, affiliation or artifact for them

roles.description: roles/reviewer_registry.json is derived by filtering people whose roles includes REVIEWER

agent_registry_ref.description: must resolve to a real registry/agent_registry.json agent_id if set

evidence_history.description: append-only record of status transitions for this entry, per PROTOCOL.md section 7 (history is not silently rewritten). A status change updates the top-level status/verified_by/verification_method/last_verified_at fields AND appends the prior state here — it never replaces it.
